content_sections.heading: About KSSM Medical officer
content_sections.text: Kerala Social Security Mission describes itself as a Government of Kerala undertaking that caters to the social security needs of the underprivileged. It is based in Thiruvananthapuram. The Medical Officer will work in the Mittayi Project, an initiative of the Government of Kerala's Social Justice Department that provides comprehensive care to children and teenagers in Kerala who have Type-1 diabetes. KSSM guides the project.

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: The notice does not require any minimum experience. However, experience is taken into account during selection, and the application form has a section for work experience. Only candidates with the prescribed qualification should apply. Ineligible applications will be rejected without further communication. Ineligible applicants may be removed at any stage of the recruitment. In the declaration on the application form, each applicant confirms that they hold MBBS with TCMC registration. The age limit is a maximum of 40 years as on 31 October 2026. In the form's declaration, the applicant also confirms that their age does not exceed 40 years as on 31/10/2026. See the official notification for the full eligibility details of the Medical Officer post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: Salary: Rs. 56,910/- per month. The notice calls this a consolidated pay. Nature of appointment: purely on a contract basis under the Mittayi Project. Contract agreement: the selected candidate must sign a contract agreement with Kerala Social Security Mission (KSSM). Term: initially one year from the date of joining. Extension: the contract appointment may be extended, depending on the candidate's performance and integrity and on what KSSM needs. The notice says the recruitment is for an immediate requirement.

content_sections.heading: KSSM Medical officer Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice lists these responsibilities for the Medical Officer: Maintain the record of all child/adolescents enrolled, recommended and rejected in the project. Analyze the data and prepare reports based on online entry. Follow up and ensure appropriate management of each of the cases. Liaison with the parents. Scrutiny of applications received via Mittayi Software and submitting the list of application before Mittayi State Technical Committee. Co-ordination of the functioning of all Mittayi Clinics. Assist and ensure smooth and proper delivery of services to Mittayi clinic associated with Medical College Hospitals and satellite centers.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection will be based on qualification, experience (if any), and performance in the written test, the interview or both, as applicable. Incomplete applications will not be considered for shortlisting. KSSM will send all communication, including the interview call letter, only by e-mail. No TA/DA will be paid for the written test or interview.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for KSSM Medical officer
content_sections.text: Fill in the application form in the prescribed format attached to the notification (reference KSSM/16/2022-A3(5), "Application for the Post of Medical Officer – Mittayi Project"). The form asks for personal details, communication and permanent addresses, mobile number and e-mail. It also asks for education details (level, stream, subject, issuing authority, year of passing, registration number, result, marks and percentage or grade) and work experience (organisation, post, start and end dates, and duration in completed months). Paste a photograph in the space marked "PHOTO" on the form. Give a valid e-mail ID, because KSSM will contact applicants only by e-mail. Attach self-attested copies of the documents that support your qualification and any experience you claim. Sign the declaration and fill in the place and date. Write "APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF MEDICAL OFFICER – MITTAYI PROJECT" on the envelope. Hand in the application or send it by post to: Executive Director, Kerala Social Security Mission, IInd Floor, Day Care Centre for Aged, Social Welfare Institutional Complex, Poojappura – 695012, Thiruvananthapuram. The deadline is 31 October 2026, 05.00 PM.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: The filled application form in the prescribed format, with a photograph. Self-attested copies of documents that support your qualification (MBBS and TCMC registration). Self-attested copies of documents that support any experience you claim. Offer letters, appointment orders and salary slips are not accepted as proof of experience. The original documents, to be shown at the interview or whenever KSSM asks for them.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: An application is rejected if the qualification or experience claimed is not supported by self-attested copies of documents. Incomplete applications will not be considered, and KSSM will not contact the applicant about them. Contact details printed in the notice: e-mail [email protected] ; phone 0471-2340090 and 0471-2341200; fax 0471-2346016. Dr Arun S Nair IAS, Executive Director, KSSM, signed the notification on 13 October 2026.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in KSSM Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for the post of Medical Officer in the Mittayi Project of Kerala Social Security Mission.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the KSSM Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: The application must be handed in or posted to KSSM on or before 31 October 2026, 05.00 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the KSSM Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: The qualification is MBBS with TCMC registration.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the KSSM Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 40 years as on 31 October 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the KSSM Medical Officer?
faq.answer: The Medical Officer gets a consolidated pay of Rs. 56,910/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for the KSSM Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: Fill in the prescribed application form attached to the notification and add self-attested copies of your documents. Then hand it in or send it by post to Executive Director, Kerala Social Security Mission, IInd Floor, Day Care Centre for Aged, Social Welfare Institutional Complex, Poojappura – 695012, Thiruvananthapuram, by 31 October 2026, 05.00 PM.

faq.question: Q7. What should be written on the envelope?
faq.answer: Write "APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF MEDICAL OFFICER – MITTAYI PROJECT" on the envelope.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the KSSM Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: Selection is based on qualification, experience (if any), and performance in the written test, the interview or both, as applicable.

faq.question: Q9. Is the KSSM Medical Officer post permanent?
faq.answer: No. The post is purely on contract, initially for one year from the date of joining. It may be extended depending on the candidate's performance and integrity and on what KSSM needs.

faq.question: Q10. Will TA/DA be paid for the written test or interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice says no TA/DA will be paid for the written test or interview.
